measurement_role_legend.baseline: Reference measurement of the query as it runs against the current schema with the default planner configuration. No index change is implied by these numbers.
measurement_role_legend.diagnostic: Diagnostic comparison of planner configurations. Reported for transparency; it does not measure the benefit of any index.

result_status_legend.valid_non_empty: The query returned a non-empty result set.
result_status_legend.invalid_empty_result: The query returned zero rows. The recorded latencies measure the cost of an empty result set and must not be used as a workload measurement.
result_status_legend.skipped: The case could not be executed, or no valid fixture could be established. The reason is recorded with the case.

planner_method_comparison.metric_definition: Latency of the same query under the default planner configuration versus the same query with enable_indexscan, enable_bitmapscan and enable_indexonlyscan forced off. The resulting ratio measures the cost of denying the planner all index access paths; it is NOT the benefit of adding an index.
